description: Land Title Settlement Department - Saranankara, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520804 (23/0093)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, owners, property extents, encumbrances, and legal rights associated with the properties. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
